# Harmonica (Accordion 02) — Task Outline & Design Notes

## Overview

- **Source**: ColorLib Accordion 02 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/accordion-02/`)
- **New Name**: Harmonica (`apps/harmonica`)
- **Category**: Restaurant / Food Menu / Interactive Accordion

## Section Breakdown & Fidelity Notes

1. **Header / Navbar**: Minimalist restaurant branding, navigation links, clean spacing.
2. **Hero / Title Section**: "Our Specialties" heading with warm typography and subtle divider lines.
3. **Accordion Menu Sections**:
   - Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Drink, Wine.
   - Smooth expand/collapse interaction.
   - Menu items featuring title, appetizing description, price, and placeholder thumbnail image (`https://picsum.photos/seed/harmonica-<item>/120/120`).
4. **Footer**: Clean attribution linking to `https://www.componentdock.com/`.
